SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-26-16349 PUC DOCKET NO. 59475
JOINT APPLICATION OF ONCOR ELECTRIC DELIVERY COMPANY LLC AND LCRA TRANSMISSION SERVICE CORPORATION TO AMEND THEIR CERTIFICATES OF CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY EAST SWITCH TO BIG HILL SUBSTATION 765-KV TRANSMISSION LINE PROJECT
Findings of Fact, Conclusion of Law, and Ordering Paragraphs
G31 Landowners, party 363

I. Proposed Findings of Fact 
A. 	Description of the Proposed Route and Proximity to Infrastructure
G31 parallels and crosses the Matterhorn Express Pipeline (42" natural gas) several times and routes directly adjacent to the Florence/Matterhorn Compressor Station (Tract #2181) within the 500-foot setback. 
G31 would cross the only ingress/egress to Florence/Matterhorn Compressor Station due to the FEMA 1% annual change flood hazard plain to the north and east of the existing facility. 
The Eiger Express Pipeline  will be 48" natural gas with a planned in-service date of mid-2028 in the same corridor as the Matterhorn Express Pipeline. Per the Monday, June 8, 2026, transcript of the Hearing on Merits page 191 starting on line 3, Mr. Marusak acknowledged he was not aware of the Eiger Express Pipeline as the routing witness.
The Florence/Matterhorn Compressor Station will double in size with the planned expansion to be due south of the existing facility due to the FEMA 1% annual change flood hazard plain to the north and east of the existing facility. 
The current routing of G31 would place the transmission lines directly above the Eiger Express Pipeline. 
Firefly Rocket Ranch test facility is located near the west end of G31 (near Briggs). 
B. 	Safety and Operational Hazards and Community/Industrial Safety Values
Constructing a high-voltage 765-kV transmission line in close proximity to  two natural gas compressor stations introduces severe, unmitigable safety risks further complicated by the one ingress/egress route for emergency response. 
Firefly Rocket Ranch testing facility has regular testing activity and related emergency responses due to explosions during testing activity.
II. Conclusions of Law
Under PURA § 37.056(c), the Commission must consider community values, safety, and the environmental integrity of the area when routing transmission infrastructure.
Any proposed route utilizing G31 presents unacceptable risks that may occur when placing a 765 VK transmission line directly adjacent and/or over two high-pressure natural gas facilities and fails to meet the safety and community value criteria established in PURA § 37.056(c).
III. Proposed Ordering Paragraphs
The Applicants’ request to consider Route 296  in their notice to Routes of Interest Map (PUC #5745) is hereby DENIED due to its utilization of link G31 which parallels/crosses two natural gas compressor stations creating unacceptable safety risks. 
Any additional route in the Applicants’ Combined Data Table utilizing link G31 is also DENIED for the same unacceptable safety risks. 
Respectfully submitted,

G31 Landowners
